title: Harnack estimates for nondivergence kinetic equations
summary:
We establish a weak Harnack inequality for nonnegative strong supersolutions and a Harnack inequality for nonnegative strong solutions of the nondivergence-form kinetic equation \[ \partial_tu+v\cdot
abla_xu+a(t,x,v):
abla_v^2u +b(t,x,v)\cdot
abla_vu+c(t,x,v)u=0, \] where the coefficients $a$, $b$, and $c$ are merely Borel measurable, the matrix $a$ is uniformly elliptic, and $b$ and $c$ are bounded.
